teaching_promise: The viewer can predict why the cheapest visible route may be less efficient than a costlier route once quality, verification, repair, fallback, and lifecycle cost are counted.

story.concrete_case: One invoice can travel through a versioned parser, small specialist, frontier model, or human-review route, each with different visible and hidden costs.
story.opening_question: Which of four differently priced invoice routes is actually efficient?
story.payoff: A one-unit route that creates eight units of repair and three of review loses to a verified nine-unit route because efficiency belongs to the complete causal bill.
story.transfer: Apply total-contract accounting to model capacity, context, search, precision, tools, verification, reusable artifacts, scaling forecasts, and routing policy.

art_direction.visual_thesis: A blue task ticket moves through a route exchange while every chosen and rejected lane leaves costs, checks, residuals, and fallback paths on one persistent bill.
art_direction.signature_image: Four illuminated rails leave one invoice turntable; the apparently cheap rail drags a long red hidden-cost tail while a costlier verified rail ends with the smaller complete bill.
art_direction.visual_world: A quiet nocturnal route exchange with one invoice, a typed task ticket, four route rails, turnstiles for authority and verification, hanging cost weights, a residual siding, and a versioned-artifact depot.
art_direction.composition_rule: The task travels left to right; candidate routes fan vertically only while selection is active, and the complete bill remains on the lower edge so costs never disappear between scenes.
art_direction.palette_rule: Cyan carries the task, copper marks compute, gold marks authority, green marks verified acceptance, magenta marks residual work, and red marks hidden or downstream cost; labels, shapes, and numeric weights duplicate color.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use route names, contract fields, short equations, and one-to-three-word cost labels; never display narration paragraphs or generic summary cards.
art_direction.motion_character: Tickets glide on rails, switches snap deliberately, cost weights drop with restrained mass, verification settles with a firm stamp, and rejected paths remain dimly visible instead of vanishing.
art_direction.camera_rule: Begin close on the invoice price tags, widen once to reveal the complete route exchange, and reframe only for the hidden-cost prediction, artifact expiry, matched-policy comparison, and closing return.
art_direction.surface_rule: Dark matte ground, fine transit-map rails, glass cost meters, no ambient particles, no decorative graph drift, and high-contrast settled states for every numeric comparison.
art_direction.ending_image: The original invoice rests beside a complete nine-unit bill, with quality, authority, verification, fallback, and repair seals visible before the ticket enters the authority chapter.

audio_direction.narration_style: Conversational and economically concrete; emphasize the opening question, the words 'No' and 'Twelve is greater than nine,' and the distinction between thrift and hidden debt.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Quick price puzzle, steady contract construction, a real arithmetic prediction pause, satisfying hidden-cost reveal, slower reuse and scaling qualification, then a crisp comparison and evidence ceiling.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music in the animatic. Any release bed must be original or rights-cleared, sparse, at least 20 dB below speech, and absent during prediction, arithmetic reveal, and evidence boundary.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: At most use a soft rail switch, cost-weight drop, verification stamp, residual warning, and expiry click; never sonify every ticket movement or let effects compete with speech.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Every route has a name and rail position; costs use numbers and weights; acceptance uses a stamp; residuals use an open attached bill; expiry uses a crossed date seal.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every switch, escalation, cost addition, and expiry ends in a distinct stable arrangement that remains understandable when paused or viewed with reduced motion.
accessibility.integrated_description: Narration names the invoice, candidate routes, dropped tax digit, repair and review bill, fallback, versioned artifact, expiry, matched policies, and evidence ceiling when each becomes visually essential.
accessibility.caption_plan: Use the balanced exact-receipt cue builder, preserve written terminology, inspect representative caption frames, and keep the lower cost ledger above the caption-safe region.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flashing, shake, spin, bounce, parallax, continuous zoom, or simultaneous multi-axis travel; rail movement is bounded and can become direct transforms in a reduced-motion derivative.

beats.narration: Four routes can read the same invoice. One costs one unit, one costs four, one costs nine, and one asks a human. Which route is efficient?
beats.visual_purpose: Create an honest price puzzle before defining efficiency.
beats.visual_action: Place one invoice on a turntable and grow four route rails with price weights of one, four, nine, and human review.
beats.attention_target: the same invoice facing four differently priced routes
beats.object_before: One invoice rests alone with no route selected.
beats.object_after: Four candidate rails and their visible prices surround the invoice.
beats.composition: Invoice centered left; four rails fan toward a shared cost axis on the right.
beats.motion_curve: Staggered ease-out rail growth followed by one settled question pause.
beats.camera_action: Static close view on the route-price puzzle.
beats.hold_purpose: Give the viewer time to choose a route before the contract is revealed.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative invoice and cost units only; no measured route performance.

beats.narration: Price alone cannot answer. The route must preserve the invoice total, vendor, date, and privacy rule under a fixed acceptance test.
beats.visual_purpose: Replace price-only choice with a prospective quality contract.
beats.visual_action: Attach total, vendor, date, and privacy seals to the invoice and place a green acceptance aperture beyond the routes.
beats.attention_target: four protected invoice fields and the acceptance aperture
beats.object_before: Routes differ only by visible price.
beats.object_after: All routes face the same four-field acceptance contract.
beats.composition: Protected fields cluster on the invoice; the test remains common to every rail.
beats.motion_curve: Short seal arrivals followed by a firm aperture close.
beats.camera_action: Hold the close view and reveal the shared test in depth.
beats.hold_purpose: Make quality prospective rather than outcome-aware.
beats.evidence_boundary: Contract illustration, not evidence that any route satisfies it.

beats.narration: So begin with a task ticket, not a model menu. The ticket names quality, authority, risk, deadline, and the cost classes we promise to count.
beats.sync_anchor: cost classes we promise to count
beats.visual_purpose: Make the task contract causally prior to route selection.
beats.visual_action: Fold the invoice seals into one cyan task ticket with quality, authority, risk, deadline, and cost tabs.
beats.attention_target: the typed ticket assembled before the route switch
beats.object_before: The invoice carries separate protected fields.
beats.object_after: One typed task ticket binds all prospective decision fields.
beats.composition: Ticket occupies the left third; unopened routes wait beyond a switch.
beats.motion_curve: Seals fold inward with a clean mechanical ease-out.
beats.camera_action: Pull back once to reveal the full route exchange.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the ticket become the persistent identity carrier.
beats.evidence_boundary: Architecture proposal at argument support.

beats.narration: Now the candidate routes become comparable: a versioned parser, a small specialist, a frontier model, and human review. Each keeps its own fallback.
beats.visual_purpose: Give candidate routes stable identities and explicit recovery paths.
beats.visual_action: Label the four rails parser, specialist, frontier, and human, then add a backward fallback switch to each.
beats.attention_target: the four named route lanes and their return switches
beats.object_before: Four priced rails are otherwise anonymous.
beats.object_after: Named candidate routes each retain a visible fallback connection.
beats.composition: Four horizontal lanes share aligned starts, tests, meters, and fallback sidings.
beats.motion_curve: Labels arrive top to bottom; fallback curves draw in reverse direction.
beats.camera_action: Static wide route-exchange view.
beats.hold_purpose: Make comparisons readable before policies act.
beats.evidence_boundary: Named hypothetical routes, not benchmarked candidates.

beats.narration: Always choosing the strongest route can preserve quality while spending nine units on every ordinary invoice. Useful work survives, but reuse never compounds.
beats.visual_purpose: Show why always-maximal is a serious but potentially wasteful baseline.
beats.visual_action: Send a train of ordinary tickets down the frontier rail, dropping nine weights per ticket while the artifact depot stays empty.
beats.attention_target: repeated nine-unit weights and the empty reuse depot
beats.object_before: All four routes are available for one ticket.
beats.object_after: Every ticket uses the frontier route and no reusable artifact accumulates.
beats.composition: Frontier lane brightens while repeated costs stack beneath it.
beats.motion_curve: Rhythmic ticket pulses with heavy cost drops and no celebratory flourish.
beats.camera_action: Track the frontier lane without hiding other routes.
beats.hold_purpose: Let waste remain visible despite accepted output.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative baseline behavior only.

beats.narration: Always choosing the cheapest route looks better until a damaged scan drops one tax digit. The one-unit answer creates repair, review, and downstream correction.
beats.visual_purpose: Show how visible thrift can create an unpriced failure tail.
beats.visual_action: Route a torn invoice through the parser, erase one tax digit, then grow repair, review, and correction weights behind the one-unit tag.
beats.attention_target: the missing digit and red hidden-cost tail
beats.object_before: The parser rail appears to cost one unit.
beats.object_after: A dropped digit causes three attached downstream cost classes.
beats.composition: Parser output remains left of a growing bill so the causal origin is explicit.
beats.motion_curve: Fast cheap passage, abrupt verification stop, then weighted downward additions.
beats.camera_action: Reframe closer on the corrupted invoice and bill.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the omitted digit legible before its costs appear.
beats.evidence_boundary: Concrete hypothetical failure, not an observed OCR result.

beats.narration: The Efficient ASI hypothesis asks for the lowest-cost authorized route that can satisfy the fixed predicate, not the lowest price on the menu.
beats.visual_purpose: State the route-selection rule using the already visible contract and candidates.
beats.visual_action: Place authority and quality gates in series on every rail, then highlight the first candidate that clears both rather than the lowest price.
beats.attention_target: the two-gate eligibility test before the cost meter
beats.object_before: Price tags can be mistaken for route eligibility.
beats.object_after: Only authorized predicate-satisfying routes enter the cost comparison.
beats.composition: Gold authority and green quality gates align before a common cost ruler.
beats.motion_curve: Firm sequential gate checks followed by a restrained eligible highlight.
beats.camera_action: Return to the wide route exchange.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent cheapest from being visually conflated with eligible.
beats.evidence_boundary: Selection rule at argument support; no optimality proof.

beats.narration: A familiar template may enter the versioned parser. Its output earns acceptance only after the required checks pass and its assumptions remain current.
beats.visual_purpose: Show a cheap route earning acceptance rather than receiving it by price.
beats.visual_action: Match the invoice template to a version seal, route it through the parser, test four protected fields, and stamp the output accepted.
beats.attention_target: the green acceptance stamp after four checks
beats.object_before: A familiar invoice is eligible for parser consideration.
beats.object_after: The parser output is accepted with current assumptions and checks visible.
beats.composition: Invoice moves along one straight parser rail through version and verification stations.
beats.motion_curve: Smooth rail travel, four crisp check pulses, then a settled stamp.
beats.camera_action: Track the parser rail at medium scale.
beats.hold_purpose: Let acceptance visibly follow verification.
beats.evidence_boundary: Hypothetical successful trace only.

beats.narration: The damaged scan fails that check. The failure stays attached to the task as a visible residual instead of becoming cheap success.
beats.visual_purpose: Keep failed cheap work durable and owned.
beats.visual_action: Stop the damaged invoice at the tax-field check and attach an open magenta residual bill to its task ticket.
beats.attention_target: the failed field and attached residual bill
beats.object_before: A damaged invoice is traveling on the cheap rail.
beats.object_after: The ticket is blocked with one named residual still attached.
beats.composition: Failed field and residual occupy one connected focal cluster.
beats.motion_curve: Decelerating stop, brief red field pulse, then a calm residual unfurl.
beats.camera_action: Static on the failed checkpoint.
beats.hold_purpose: Give the failure an inspectable stable state.
beats.evidence_boundary: Accounting behavior, not measured residual burden.

beats.narration: Fallback then escalates the same ticket to a stronger specialist or a human. The failed attempt remains on the bill and in the learning record.
beats.sync_anchor: failed attempt remains on the bill
beats.visual_purpose: Show escalation without erasing the first attempt's cost or identity.
beats.visual_action: Throw the fallback switch, move the same ticket to the specialist rail, and copy the parser failure into both bill and learning ledger.
beats.attention_target: the unchanged ticket identity crossing to fallback with its cost attached
beats.object_before: The parser route is blocked with an owned residual.
beats.object_after: The same ticket escalates while the failed attempt remains recorded.
beats.composition: Fallback curve links parser and specialist; bill stays anchored below the ticket.
beats.motion_curve: Switch snaps, ticket follows a smooth curve, record copies land with soft ease-out.
beats.camera_action: Follow the fallback curve without cutting away.
beats.hold_purpose: Preserve causal attribution across escalation.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative escalation, not route-performance evidence.

beats.narration: Total contract cost includes generation, context, routing, verification, repair, review, rollback preparation, maintenance, delayed failure, and displaced work.
beats.visual_purpose: Make the full denominator visible without narrating a dashboard.
beats.visual_action: Extend the persistent bill into ten labeled cost weights and balance direct spend against lifecycle and displaced costs.
beats.attention_target: the complete bill growing beyond generation cost
beats.object_before: The bill contains route price and one failed attempt.
beats.object_after: Ten cost classes share one total-contract denominator.
beats.composition: Two rows of five compact weights feed one total meter; the invoice remains small but visible.
beats.motion_curve: Staggered weight drops with increasing mass and a settled total line.
beats.camera_action: Widen downward to include the whole bill.
beats.hold_purpose: Let viewers scan every cost class once.
beats.evidence_boundary: Cost taxonomy only; no calibrated estimates.

beats.narration: Now predict. If the cheap route costs one, repair costs eight, and review costs three, is it more efficient than a verified nine-unit route?
beats.visual_purpose: Require the viewer to compute the complete bill before the reveal.
beats.visual_action: Place one, eight, and three on the cheap-route scale opposite a single verified nine, pause before either side is totaled.
beats.attention_target: the unresolved balance between one-plus-eight-plus-three and nine
beats.object_before: Cost classes are visible but not compared.
beats.object_after: Two complete candidate bills wait on an unresolved balance.
beats.composition: Cheap-route components left, verified nine right, empty totals centered.
beats.motion_curve: Weights settle individually, followed by a true still prediction interval.
beats.camera_action: Push in once on the arithmetic balance.
beats.hold_purpose: Give enough time to add the left side before narration answers.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative arithmetic only.

beats.narration: No. Twelve is greater than nine, and the hidden-cost win disappears. Efficiency belongs to the complete causal route, not its cheapest visible meter.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the price puzzle with the chapter's denominator.
beats.visual_action: Sum the cheap bill to twelve, tilt the balance toward nine, and redraw the one-unit badge as only one component of the losing route.
beats.attention_target: the complete twelve-versus-nine comparison
beats.object_before: The balance shows unsummed cost components.
beats.object_after: The verified nine-unit route has the lower complete bill.
beats.composition: Large 12 and 9 anchor opposite sides; the one-unit label shrinks into the twelve stack.
beats.motion_curve: Crisp sum reveal, weighted tilt, then a calm settled comparison.
beats.camera_action: Hold the close arithmetic view.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the central inequality land before abstraction resumes.
beats.evidence_boundary: Resolves the hypothetical only; does not establish empirical efficiency.

beats.narration: Repeated verified work can become a parser, cache, tool, memory, proof, or specialist. But the artifact carries a version, assumptions, tests, and renewal cost.
beats.visual_purpose: Show reuse as governed amortization rather than free intelligence.
beats.visual_action: Carry accepted invoice traces into an artifact depot and assemble one versioned module with assumption, test, and renewal tags.
beats.attention_target: the reusable artifact and its three attached obligations
beats.object_before: Verified work ends as individual accepted outputs.
beats.object_after: Repeated work compiles into one obligation-bearing reusable artifact.
beats.composition: Accepted traces converge into a depot at center; obligation tags remain outside the artifact shell.
beats.motion_curve: Convergent transforms followed by sequential tag attachment.
beats.camera_action: Pan from route exchange to the adjacent artifact depot.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent reuse from appearing obligation-free.
beats.evidence_boundary: Compilation design, not measured reuse benefit.

beats.narration: When the invoice format changes, the cached route expires. Revalidation is not overhead added afterward; it prevents yesterday's saving from becoming tomorrow's debt.
beats.visual_purpose: Show that reusable work remains efficient only while its assumptions stay current.
beats.visual_action: Change the invoice template from version three to four, break the artifact's assumption seal, and divert it to revalidation instead of execution.
beats.attention_target: the crossed version seal and revalidation siding
beats.object_before: Parser version three is current and reusable.
beats.object_after: Template version four expires the route and opens revalidation work.
beats.composition: Old and new version seals face each other above an explicit revalidation branch.
beats.motion_curve: One controlled version flip, seal fracture, and slow diversion.
beats.camera_action: Stay at the artifact depot for the expiry event.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the stale-artifact failure remain visible.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative invalidation trigger, not a measured cache failure.

beats.narration: The routed resource can be model capacity, context, search, numerical precision, tools, or verification. Minimum viable intelligence is a candidate policy, not an axiom.
beats.visual_purpose: Generalize the invoice routes beyond small-versus-large models.
beats.visual_action: Transform the four route rails into six adjustable resource dials while leaving the same task predicate and total bill fixed around them.
beats.attention_target: six resource dials inside one unchanged contract
beats.object_before: Routing appears to choose only among model-sized lanes.
beats.object_after: Capacity, context, search, precision, tools, and verification are substitutable routed resources.
beats.composition: Six dials arc around the fixed ticket and bill without forming a decorative dashboard.
beats.motion_curve: Matched rail-to-dial transformations with one deliberate no-axiom stop bar.
beats.camera_action: Widen to the generalized resource field.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the generalization readable without implying universal savings.
beats.evidence_boundary: Policy vocabulary only; no universal optimum.

beats.narration: For novel, uncertain, or high-consequence work, the strongest route plus broad verification may dominate. The architecture must be allowed to learn that selectivity has no value there.
beats.visual_purpose: State the hypothesis's natural weakening condition.
beats.visual_action: Raise novelty, uncertainty, and consequence gauges until the strong route and broad verifier become the lowest complete-risk option.
beats.attention_target: the risk gauges legitimately selecting the strong route
beats.object_before: Selective routing appears generally preferable.
beats.object_after: One high-risk regime selects maximal capability and verification without contradiction.
beats.composition: Three risk gauges rise on the left; strong route and verifier align on the right.
beats.motion_curve: Slow gauge rise followed by a clean switch to the maximal verified lane.
beats.camera_action: Static regime-comparison frame.
beats.hold_purpose: Make a legitimate always-strong outcome feel allowed, not defeated.
beats.evidence_boundary: Conceptual regime boundary, not calibrated risk routing.

beats.narration: Scaling forecasts still matter, but a smooth loss curve is not a capability guarantee. Preserve forecast residuals and watch operational thresholds without declaring every jump real or illusory.
beats.visual_purpose: Integrate scaling and emergence without turning either into route authority.
beats.visual_action: Draw a smooth loss curve beside stepped operational scores, place a threshold gate across both, and retain forecast errors as residual markers rather than erasing them.
beats.attention_target: the disagreement between smooth fit, stepped score, and retained residuals
beats.object_before: Routing costs and risks are shown without capability forecasting.
beats.object_after: Smooth forecasts, threshold metrics, and residuals coexist without a global emergence verdict.
beats.composition: Two aligned plots share one threshold; residual markers remain outside the fitted line.
beats.motion_curve: Curve draws smoothly, steps appear discretely, residuals pop in and persist.
beats.camera_action: Reframe to one clean forecasting plane.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the two measurement shapes remain visibly distinct.
beats.evidence_boundary: Comparator synthesis only; no local scaling or emergence result.

beats.narration: A fair test freezes natural tasks, then compares always-cheapest, always-maximal, adaptive routing, and a strong monolith with tools under matched access and tuning.
beats.visual_purpose: Define the baselines that can falsify the allocation hypothesis.
beats.visual_action: Place four policy vehicles on one frozen task track and attach identical model access, tools, tuning, and observation kits to each.
beats.attention_target: four policies sharing the same equipment and task track
beats.object_before: The argument has shown one route economy in isolation.
beats.object_after: Four serious policies stand under matched comparison conditions.
beats.composition: Four parallel lanes share a single header of matched resources and frozen tasks.
beats.motion_curve: Vehicles assemble without racing or declaring a winner.
beats.camera_action: Widen to the matched-policy comparison.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep all baselines equally legible and undefeated.
beats.evidence_boundary: Prospective test design, not a completed comparison.

beats.narration: Score useful accepted work against total contract cost. Count unsafe effects, false refusals, recovery, latency, human burden, tail failures, and maintenance together.
beats.visual_purpose: Define the joint outcome frontier without a single-score victory.
beats.visual_action: Build a numerator of accepted useful work over the persistent total bill, then add seven independent outcome counters around the ratio.
beats.attention_target: useful accepted work divided by the complete bill
beats.object_before: Four policies share conditions but lack an outcome measure.
beats.object_after: A joint frontier retains usefulness, harm, refusal, recovery, time, labor, tails, and maintenance.
beats.composition: Central ratio dominates; outcome counters orbit with equal visual weight and no aggregate winner.
beats.motion_curve: Ratio assembles first, then counters arrive in a measured radial sequence.
beats.camera_action: Static on the evaluation surface.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent a cheap aggregate from hiding a failed dimension.
beats.evidence_boundary: Measurement contract only; no reported result.

beats.narration: This chapter does not contain that result. Its support remains an argument; finite route fixtures organize accounting but prove no measured efficiency, transfer, safety, or ASI.
beats.visual_purpose: End the comparison at the chapter's actual evidence ceiling.
beats.visual_action: Enclose the invoice trace and finite fixture inside a double proof boundary while measured efficiency, transfer, safety, and ASI remain outside.
beats.attention_target: the current-support boundary and excluded conclusions
beats.object_before: The proposed comparison and metrics are fully visible.
beats.object_after: Only the accounting argument and finite fixture remain inside current support.
beats.composition: Double boundary centered; unsupported conclusions align beyond its lower edge.
beats.motion_curve: Quiet enclosure, then restrained outside-label reveal.
beats.camera_action: Pull back to the complete evidence boundary.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the evidence ceiling readable before the callback.
beats.evidence_boundary: Explicitly denies measured efficiency, deployment, transfer, safety, and ASI support.

beats.narration: Return to the invoice. Efficiency means the saving remains visible after quality, authority, verification, fallback, and repair are paid. Next, System Boundaries and Authority defines where permission stops.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the opening route puzzle and hand the ticket to the authority chapter.
beats.visual_action: Restore the invoice beside its complete nine-unit bill, light quality, authority, verification, fallback, and repair seals, then send the same ticket toward an authority boundary.
beats.attention_target: the fully accounted invoice ticket crossing toward the next chapter
beats.object_before: The evidence boundary contains the finite route argument.
beats.object_after: The opening invoice is resolved and its ticket reaches the authority handoff.
beats.composition: Resolved invoice and complete bill occupy the left; the next authority gate opens on the right.
beats.motion_curve: Slow callback assembly, five seal pulses, then one steady rightward handoff.
beats.camera_action: Return to the opening composition and pan slightly toward the next gate.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the complete-accounting definition close the loop.
beats.evidence_boundary: Handoff preserves argument support and grants no authority result.
